title: Premature ejaculation
intro: Premature ejaculation means ejaculating sooner than the man or his partner would like, with little sense of control. It is one of the most common sexual concerns in men and can cause distress and relationship strain. It is treatable with behavioural techniques, medicines and counselling.

sections.heading: What it is
paragraphs: Definitions vary, but doctors consider the problem when ejaculation regularly happens within about a minute of penetration, or before desired, and causes distress. It may have existed since first sexual experiences or may develop later. Occasional early ejaculation is common and not a disorder.

sections.heading: Possible causes
paragraphs: Causes can be psychological, such as performance anxiety, stress, relationship difficulties or depression, and biological, such as heightened sensitivity, hormonal or thyroid problems, prostate inflammation or erectile difficulties. Often several factors interact, and worry about performance tends to make the problem worse.

sections.heading: Seeing a doctor
paragraphs: A doctor will ask about the history, general health, medicines and relationship, and examine the genitals. Blood tests are rarely needed. Talking openly can be hard, but the problem is common and doctors are used to discussing it.

sections.heading: Treatment options
paragraphs: Behavioural methods such as the stop-start technique and squeeze technique train control by pausing stimulation before the point of no return. Pelvic floor exercises may help. Sex therapy or couples counselling addresses anxiety and communication. Thick condoms or numbing sprays and creams reduce sensitivity. Certain antidepressants taken regularly or before intercourse delay ejaculation, and specific on-demand tablets exist in some countries. Side effects include nausea, reduced libido and dizziness.

sections.heading: Involving your partner
paragraphs: Involving your partner reduces pressure and allows you to try techniques together. Focusing on intimacy beyond intercourse, for example other forms of touch, can relieve stress. Set realistic expectations and be patient, since improvement takes weeks of practice.

examples.title: Starting a conversation
examples.text: Imagine you feel embarrassed to discuss this. You could write down your main concerns, say plainly how long ejaculation takes and how it affects you, and ask about the options.

examples.title: Trying a technique
examples.text: Suppose you and your partner decide to try the stop-start method. You might agree to practise several times a week, with no pressure for intercourse, and review progress after a month.
